pages.text: Offer two Clay Balls and two Wood Ash separately. All three circles must already be complete, in any mix of non-focal chalks. Hold the desired chalk in your offhand with at least 40 uses left.

Pay 450 starting power, or 382 with Hecate's Visage. Only the forty large-ring glyphs are repainted. There is no ongoing power cost or output. As with other drawing recipes, success consumes the offerings immediately.
